verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag platform, so stale-flag detection and code-reference tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents either capability. Tags, the `protected` flag, audit logs and Admin API deletion are adjacent flag-management features that do not identify stale flags or locate their references in code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase
